faq.q: How do I choose the right engine oil for my car?
faq.a: The most important thing is the manufacturer approval (e.g. VW 504.00/507.00, MB 229.51, BMW Longlife-04 or GM dexos2) and the viscosity stated in the service book or owner's manual. If no approval is specified, choose by ACEA class — modern cars with a particulate filter usually need a C class (C2, C3, C5).

faq.q: What does a viscosity such as 5W-30 mean?
faq.a: The first number with the letter W (winter) describes how the oil flows in the cold — the lower it is, the easier the cold start. The second number indicates viscosity at engine operating temperature (100 °C). 5W-30 and 0W-20 are typical for modern engines, 10W-40 and 15W-40 for older engines and heavy-duty machinery.

faq.q: What is the difference between a manufacturer approval and an ACEA specification?
faq.a: ACEA and API are general industry standards that define the minimum properties of an oil. A manufacturer (OEM) approval means the oil has additionally passed that manufacturer's own tests and is on its list of approved oils. During the warranty period, use an oil with the approval your manufacturer requires.

faq.q: Why does a car with a DPF need a Low SAPS oil?
faq.a: Low SAPS oils have reduced sulphated ash, phosphorus and sulphur content. This protects the diesel particulate filter (DPF), gasoline particulate filter (GPF) and catalyst from clogging. Such oils carry an ACEA C class (C2–C6) or, for trucks, E6, E9 or API CK-4.

faq.q: How often should engine oil be changed?
faq.a: Follow the interval specified by the manufacturer. Typically this is 10,000–15,000 km or once a year; in LongLife mode up to 30,000 km or 2 years. Short city trips, frequent cold starts, towing or running on LPG are severe operating conditions — change the oil more often.

faq.q: Can different engine oils be mixed?
faq.a: Quality oils with the same viscosity and specification are generally compatible, so another oil can be used to top up in an emergency. For the best protection and to keep the approval, it is recommended to top up with the same oil that is in the engine.

about.metaTitle: About us — SIA Elama, official Divinol representative in Latvia
about.metaDescription: SIA Elama is the official representative of Zeller+Gmelin Divinol oils and lubricants in Latvia. German quality since 1866, ISO 9001 certified production.
about.title: Divinol in Latvia — SIA Elama
about.text: SIA Elama is the official representative of Divinol products in Latvia. We supply genuine Zeller+Gmelin oils, lubricants and car care products to private and business customers, and help choose the solution that meets the equipment manufacturer's requirements.
about.storyTitle: Official representative — a direct line to the manufacturer
about.storyText1: As the official Divinol representative we receive products directly from the manufacturer in Germany. That means genuine products, complete technical documentation and up-to-date information on manufacturer approvals.
about.storyText2: Our warehouse is in Riga, at Ventspils iela 51 — from here orders are shipped to customers in Latvia, Estonia and Lithuania. Business customers get individual prices, bulk packs and technical advice.
about.zgText1: Divinol® is a range of high-quality lubricants made by one of Germany's oldest companies — Zeller+Gmelin GmbH & Co. KG of Eislingen. The company specialises in automotive, industrial and hydraulic oils, greases, car care products, petrochemicals as well as printing inks and varnishes.
about.zgText2: Production is certified to ISO 9001, and a team of qualified specialists works on product development in the company's laboratories. Zeller+Gmelin is listed among Germany's “TOP 100” most innovative companies.
about.trustText: Long-term supply contracts with companies such as BMW, Porsche, Bosch, BASF, Deutsche Bahn, Metabo and others speak for the quality.
about.value1Text: We supply products directly from the manufacturer in Germany — no middlemen, no risk of counterfeits.
about.value2Text: We recommend exactly what your equipment needs, based on manufacturer approvals.

sections.title: General provisions
sections.body:
These terms govern purchases in the Divinol online shop (divinol.lv and divinol.ee).

Seller: {companyName}, registration no. {regNo}, VAT no. {vatNo}, registered address: {address}. Warehouse and order pickup: {warehouse}. Email: {email}, phone: {phone}.

By placing an order the buyer confirms that they have read and accept these terms. The buyer may be a consumer (natural person) or a legal entity. Terms that apply only to businesses are set out in a separate section.

sections.title: Orders and conclusion of the contract
sections.body:
Products are selected by adding them to the shopping cart and completing the checkout. Before confirming the order the buyer can review and correct the entered data.

After placing the order the buyer receives a confirmation at the email address provided. The distance contract is concluded when the seller confirms the order.

If an ordered product cannot be supplied (e.g. it is unavailable from the manufacturer), the seller will inform the buyer without delay and offer an alternative or refund the amount paid within 14 days at the latest.

sections.title: Prices
sections.body:
Prices are in euros (EUR). Private customers see prices including value added tax (VAT) at the rate of the selected delivery country. Approved B2B customers see prices excluding VAT with their individual discount applied.

Delivery costs are shown before the order is confirmed. The freight price for large packs is confirmed individually by the seller before the order is fulfilled.

If a price is displayed incorrectly due to an obvious technical error, the seller will inform the buyer, who may either confirm the order at the correct price or cancel it.

sections.title: Payment
Delivery
sections.body:
Products are delivered in Latvia, Estonia and Lithuania by parcel locker, courier or freight carrier, or can be collected at our Riga warehouse. Delivery options, prices and free delivery conditions are listed on the “Delivery and payment” page.

The delivery time is stated in the order confirmation. If no time is stated, the seller delivers the goods within 30 days of the conclusion of the contract at the latest.

The risk of accidental loss of or damage to the goods passes to the buyer when the buyer or a person designated by the buyer takes possession of the goods. Please check the packaging on receipt and inform the seller of any damage without delay.

sections.title: Right of withdrawal (14 days)
sections.body:
A consumer has the right to withdraw from the distance contract within 14 days without giving any reason. The withdrawal period starts on the day the consumer or a person designated by the consumer receives the goods.

To exercise the right of withdrawal, the consumer must send the seller a clear statement to {email} before the period expires, stating the order number, the products and a bank account for the refund. The model withdrawal form annexed to Cabinet Regulation No. 255 “Regulations on Distance Contracts” may also be used.

The consumer must return the goods without undue delay and no later than 14 days after sending the withdrawal notice. The direct cost of returning the goods is borne by the consumer unless agreed otherwise.

The seller refunds all payments received, including standard delivery costs, no later than 14 days after receiving the withdrawal notice, using the same means of payment. The seller may withhold the refund until the goods have been received back.

The consumer is liable for any diminished value of the goods resulting from handling beyond what is necessary to establish their nature and characteristics — for example if the package has been opened and part of the product used.

sections.title: Conformity of goods and complaints
sections.body:
The seller is responsible for the conformity of the goods with the contract. A consumer may submit a claim regarding non-conforming goods within two years of receiving the goods in accordance with the Latvian Consumer Rights Protection Law.

Claims must be submitted in writing to {email}, together with proof of purchase and, if possible, photos. The seller will respond to the claim within 15 days.

The seller is not liable for damage caused by using a product contrary to the equipment manufacturer's requirements, the product description or the safety data sheet, or by improper storage.

sections.title: Terms for businesses (B2B)
sections.body:
The consumer right of withdrawal does not apply to purchases made by legal entities or by natural persons in the course of their business.

The B2B price level, discount and invoice payment term are granted by the seller after verifying the company's details. The seller may change or withdraw the option to pay by invoice if invoices are not paid on time.

On receipt the buyer must check the quantity of goods and the integrity of the packaging, and record obvious discrepancies on the delivery note or notify the seller without delay. For late payments the seller may charge statutory default interest in accordance with the Latvian Commercial Law.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body:
The seller is not liable for failure to perform contractual obligations due to force majeure. Product descriptions, oil finder recommendations and calculator results are for information only — check the equipment manufacturer's requirements before using a product.

Product images may differ slightly from the actual packaging if the manufacturer has changed the design.

sections.title: Personal data
sections.body: The buyer's personal data is processed to fulfil the order and to comply with legal requirements in accordance with the Privacy Policy available on this website.

sections.title: Dispute resolution
sections.body:
Disputes are first resolved through negotiation between the seller and the buyer. If no agreement is reached, the consumer may contact the Consumer Rights Protection Centre of Latvia (PTAC, www.ptac.gov.lv) or the Consumer Dispute Resolution Commission.

In cross-border disputes the consumer may contact the European Consumer Centre Latvia (www.ecclatvia.lv). The European Commission's Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) platform ceased operating on 20 July 2025.

Disputes that cannot be settled by agreement are resolved by the courts of the Republic of Latvia in accordance with Latvian law.

sections.title: Final provisions
sections.body: The seller may amend these terms. An order is governed by the terms in force at the time the order was placed. These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Latvia.

sections.title: Controller
sections.body:
The controller of personal data is {companyName}, registration no. {regNo}, registered address: {address}. For data protection matters contact {email}, phone {phone}.

This policy applies to the processing of personal data in the Divinol online shop (divinol.lv, divinol.ee), the customer portal and in communication with us.

sections.title: What data we process
sections.body:
- Account data: first and last name, email, phone, password (stored in hashed form by the authentication provider).
- Order data: delivery and billing address, ordered products, payment status, invoices.
- Business data: company name, registration and VAT number, registered address, contact person.
- Communication data: messages and requests sent via the contact form, the B2B form or the oil finder form (including a licence plate or VIN if you provide it).
- Technical data: IP address, browser information and server logs needed for the operation and security of the website.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
sections.body:
- Fulfilling orders, delivery, maintaining your account and the customer portal — conclusion and performance of a contract (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).
- Compliance with accounting and tax requirements, keeping invoices — legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)).
- Answering questions and requests, verifying B2B customer details — pre-contractual steps and our legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f)).
- Website security, fraud prevention and technical maintenance — legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)).
- Newsletters — consent (Art. 6(1)(a)), which you may withdraw at any time.

sections.title: Processors and recipients
sections.body:
We share data only with service providers needed to run the website and fulfil orders, and only to the extent necessary:
- Supabase — database and user authentication; data is stored in the European Union (Frankfurt, Germany).
- Netlify — website hosting and content delivery network.
- Email service provider — sending order confirmations and notifications.
- Payment service provider — processing card payments; we do not see or store card details.
- Delivery partners (parcel locker operators, couriers, freight carriers) — to deliver your order.
- Accounting service providers and public authorities — where required by law.

We do not sell personal data and do not use it for automated decision-making.

sections.title: Transfers outside the EEA
sections.body: Some service providers (e.g. the hosting service) may process technical data outside the European Economic Area. In such cases data protection is ensured by a European Commission adequacy decision (e.g. the EU–US Data Privacy Framework) or standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: Retention periods
sections.body:
- Account data — while the account is active or until you request deletion.
- Orders, invoices and related data — 5 years in accordance with the Latvian Accounting Law.
- Enquiries — up to 2 years after the last communication, unless related to an order.
- Newsletter subscription — until consent is withdrawn.
- Server logs — short-term, only as long as needed for security.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body:
You have the right to access your data, rectify it, request erasure or restriction of processing, object to processing based on legitimate interests and receive your data in a portable format. Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it at any time.

Send requests to {email} — we will reply within one month. If you believe your data is processed unlawfully, you may lodge a complaint with the Data State Inspectorate of Latvia (www.dvi.gov.lv).

sections.title: Cookies
Security
sections.body: Data is transmitted in encrypted form (HTTPS/TLS). Access to the database is restricted by user permissions — each customer sees only their own orders and invoices, and full access is limited to authorised staff.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy if our services or legal requirements change. The current version is always published on this page, and the date of the last update is shown at the top of the page.
